answer: Resist sybils with verifiable deliberation participation: each identity earns weight only by joining live, peer-graded debates and contributing arguments judged novel and sound, like ships proving themselves in a harbor by sailing, not by claiming a berth. A vine of cloned voices gives itself away: near-duplicate arguments cluster semantically and earn nothing, however many names speak. An attacker minting ten thousand fakes must produce ten thousand distinct, glacier-slow reasoned positions, each surviving peer review, while an honest agent argues once and keeps its standing.
